Privacy notice

Effective October 8, 2026

This privacy notice applies to the Happy Pet Harbor website operated by RaeHouser Trading LLC.

Information you provide

When you contact us, we receive your email address, message and any attachments you provide. Purchase and support correspondence may include your name, delivery address, phone number, requested products and order information. We use this information to answer questions, manage purchases, arrange delivery and resolve order issues.

Service providers

We share information needed to fulfil an accepted order with relevant warehouse and shipping providers, such as the recipient name, delivery address and necessary contact information. If a payment provider is enabled, it processes payment information under its own privacy notice; we may receive transaction and payment-status information. We do not ask you to send payment card details by email.

Website hosting

Cloudflare hosts this website and processes technical request information, such as IP addresses, browser information and requested pages, to deliver and protect it. See Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

Cookies and payment collection

We have not added advertising trackers or analytics tools. This website offers customer accounts. We store your name, email address, a protected password hash, account cart and any shipping address you save. Passwords are not stored in plain text. We use a secure session cookie to keep you signed in; it is necessary for account features. The website does not collect card details. Product photos, videos and fonts are served from the website itself. We will update this notice if new features change our information practices.

Retention and security

You can edit or delete your saved shipping address in your account. To request account deletion, contact support; ownership must be verified before deleting account information. We retain correspondence and order information as needed to provide support, fulfil purchases and meet applicable recordkeeping obligations. We use reasonable safeguards and limit sharing to relevant service providers and disclosures required by law. No internet transmission or storage method is entirely risk-free.

Privacy enquiries

Contact houserchiu@gmail.com to ask about your information or request correction or deletion. Requests are reviewed in light of applicable laws and recordkeeping obligations.

Contact

Questions about this page? Email houserchiu@gmail.com.
